name: A Tinker can take Scrapmaw from its first specialization point (#4442)
contract: #4442 reports a level 15 Tinker playerbot with a Scrapmaw pet and treats it as a spell outside its level. Scrapmaw 500242 is CharacterAdvancement entry 29206 on the Mechanics tab 75: TalentEssenceCost 1, AbilityEssenceCost 0, level 0, no required entries and TabTEInvestment 8, so 8 TE must already be spent on shallower Mechanics entries before it. CharacterAdvancementEssence gives class 28 no specialization point at level 10, one at 11 and nine at level 27. The Mechanics specialization (ChrSpecs 50) needs class entry 29203 (804673, AE, ungated). 'tinker15' is level 27 so its 9 TE points cover 8 ungated Mechanics entries plus Scrapmaw itself; it then buys Scrapmaw through the native upload. A level 10 Tinker is refused for want of any specialization point at all (the original, level-independent regression this scenario still guards).
